scope: Isolated synthetic mathematical probes, not full application QA or live/performance validation.

directionTie.interpretation: A higher/equal preliminary short score can suppress an otherwise eligible long plan when the selected short side has no target. This is a policy/eligibility counterexample, not a measurement of market frequency.

positionSizing.interpretation: Nominal stop-distance sizing has no spot-cash cap, step-size rounding or costs; this is not an executable unleveraged spot size.

noLossProfitFactor.interpretation: 99 is a display sentinel, not the mathematical ratio when the denominator is zero. Use an explicit unavailable/no-loss state.

zeroTradeInterval.interpretation: The aggregate routine uses max(N,1), manufacturing a nonempty-denominator Wilson interval when N=0. The on-screen no-trade branch hides metrics, but the report path still formats these values. Use unavailable statistics for N=0.
